title: Wilton Crawley records and Larry Metcalf
summary: Wilton Crawley's Victor records are played; Barbarin has never heard them, guesses the players and tries to find the record.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him
